notes.title: QLuLu_今日もかわいい
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a while. I'm Mr.H. During this time, besides watching VTubers and creating my Hypnosis prison, I've also been researching the latest trend in AI-generated art.When COMET-chan appeared on April Fool's Day this year, I decided to try using simple AI-generated art to create a small game, which I released on dlsite. The whole process took about two months, just a simple try for AI

https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01062808.html

Due to my full-time job, I don't have much time for editing graphics in AL games, so I use it as a way to express my desire to idols! If you're interested, you can give it a try or provide some suggestions. Most of my efforts are still focused on creating the Hypnosis prison, but when I watch live streams and get inspired to create small-scale themed H games, I may create another game with AI

I hope to create H games featuring all my favorite idols before I get too old.きゅるるん 今日もかわいい
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614476/941e522fd7a783f995c7fdf8f732b9e6caade792.png[/img]
